### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode

She never proposes a figure, a longer term or another arrangement; brings up nothing else; accepts the new amount herself when handed over "using exactly the plan reference and the amount they read out"; pays nothing today; keeps card autopay on the 16th; if told something else must be booked or the plan will change first, asks for a brief explanation then says go ahead; if told of another knee-surgery bill, says she had not noticed it. Passive/conditional; executes the user tool only when handed over.
